Doc.aspx is shared by Word/Excel/PowerPoint; the app is decided by the extension in the file= param (substring match on query), NOT by action= (action is default/edit/view/embedview). Real .docx example seen in sharepointr README; other extensions by analogy. Check longest extension first (.docx before .doc)
